articles.title: How South Korea’s proposed 20% cap could change who runs Upbit
articles.snippet: Naver Financial agreed to buy every share in Upbit’s operator, but a proposed ownership cap could strip away its voting rights on four-fifths of them.

articles.title: South Korea proposes bank-led stablecoins, 20% cap on crypto exchange stakes
articles.snippet: The draft bill would also reopen domestic initial coin offerings after a ban dating to 2017 and require issuers to disclose risks before soliciting buyers.

articles.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Insiders Fear Their Next AI Models Are Too Dangerous to Release
articles.snippet: Employees at both AI labs reportedly question whether their strongest models should ever reach the public, as researchers struggle to keep increasingly capable systems under control during training and testing.
